hydrographyAccessReview.finding: NAMRIA's Information Systems Portal describes the Maritime Information System (MarIS) as a platform to store, view, share and download Hydrography Branch spatial and non-spatial data, but says MarIS is accessible to the Hydrography Branch only within the NAMRIA network.
hydrographyAccessReview.gapanLayerPresence: unknown; the restricted system was not accessed
hydrographyAccessReview.decision: Do not treat MarIS as an open public download or attempt internal access. Ask NAMRIA through an authorized public-products inquiry whether a shareable, licensed channel dataset or suitable topographic source exists for Gapan River; separately ask DENR, PRA and Ternate LGU for endpoints or a station-to-channel crosswalk for the one-kilometer Adopt-a-Waterbody segment.

limitations: The DENR one-kilometer figure describes a program segment only; it is not the full river length or a mapped boundary.
The sources do not resolve whether Gapan River is a tributary, branch or other component of the separately listed Maragondon River channel.
No fish survey, validated species list, station coordinate, full channel geometry or salinity evidence was located.
Indexed official content was reviewed because direct page requests returned HTTP 403; no access-control bypass was attempted.
Item-specific reuse terms remain unverified, so no page content or media is reproduced.
nextAction: Ask NAMRIA through an authorized public-products inquiry whether it can identify a permitted Gapan channel dataset or suitable map; ask DENR, PRA and Ternate LGU for the one-kilometer Adopt-a-Waterbody segment endpoints or a station-to-channel crosswalk. MarIS is restricted to NAMRIA's Hydrography Branch intranet and was not accessed. Continue dated fish and water-quality searches for the exact reach; keep the segment separate from the full channel, geometry and salinity unresolved, and make no public species claim until evidence is independently reviewed.
